notes: 24 modules: fit + fight per stage, exercises/drills taken from the Ultra Instinct source scripts. APPLIES THE ARCADE SESSION STANDARD (specs/27, data/arcade-session-standards.json). FIT modules carry a counted `prescription` (sets x reps/sec + category + tier); stored numbers are the NORMAL baseline, the app re-resolves easy/hard from the volume ladder by tier+category. FIGHT modules carry `round_source`, a `canonical_map` (thematic instinct/flow drill -> canonical discipline + move), and a `finishers` block (explosive bodyweight, capped, counting toward the plyo cap). Tier map: T1 stages 1-3, T2 4-6, T3 7-9, T4 10-12 — taper stages 10-11 stay DELOAD-LIGHT (no tier ladder). 'difficulty' is the normal baseline; round counts/lengths/rests resolve from campaign.difficulty_scaling.fight per selected difficulty (Stage 12 boss overrides). Taper stages 10-11 apply campaign.stage_load_multiplier. Split stages are SKILL-FIRST: fight = morning (S1), fit = evening (S2). Meditation blocks are completion-only; meditation/breathing/flow-visualization rounds are cue-based, never combo-generated.

both_rules.description: When a stage is run as BOTH (fit + fight combined).
both_rules.sequencing: Skill/fight first while fresh, then fit. Stages 4-10 are already skill-first split (fight = AM, fit = PM); stages 1-3 and 11-12 are single-session, so BOTH runs fight -> fit back-to-back.
both_rules.shared_plyo_cap: The campaign plyo foot-contact cap is counted ACROSS the whole session — fight finishers + fit explosive share it; if combined would exceed it, the fit explosive block trims first.
both_rules.volume_sanity: In a single-session BOTH (stages 1-3, 11-12), fit accessory volume may drop one notch so two full high-volume blocks aren't stacked; taper stages 11-12 stay light regardless.
both_rules.readiness: A BOTH day is a HARD day: readiness gate applies before starting, and it won't schedule back-to-back with another hard day.
both_rules.announcer: States the combined plan up front (e.g. 'Stage 6: See It Coming. Fight — 6 rounds. Then Fit — Reactive Speed, 5 workouts.').
